players.product: LPCVD / ALD single-wafer and batch deposition systems for DRAM

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 223,984M vs KRW 188,078M in H1 2025; H1 operating profit KRW 37,054M vs KRW 28,943M. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 122,110M (Q2 2025: KRW 104,925M), operating profit KRW 18,221M (Q2 2025: KRW 19,740M). Semiconductor-equipment segment revenue KRW 216,271M with operating profit KRW 34,979M; industrial gas / precursor subsidiary EGTM revenue KRW 7,714M. Exports KRW 72,115M (32.20% of revenue). H1 net profit of KRW 88,773M was lifted by an income-tax benefit of KRW 36,298,836 thousand that the report attributes to a corporate-tax refund claim.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 223,984M (H1 2025 KRW 188,078M); H1 OP KRW 37,054M (H1 2025 KRW 28,943M); Q2 revenue KRW 122,110M, Q2 OP KRW 18,221M; net profit KRW 88,773M incl. tax benefit

quarterly_data.signal: Front-end equipment order backlog: KRW 153,311,617 thousand at 06-30-2026, up from KRW 95,645,534 thousand at the start of the year, after new contracts of KRW 248,977,933 thousand and revenue recognised of KRW 191,311,850 thousand in H1 2026 (H1 2025: new contracts KRW 146,561,538 thousand, backlog KRW 68,832,516 thousand at mid-year).
quarterly_data.figure: Equipment backlog KRW 153,311,617 thousand (start of year KRW 95,645,534 thousand); H1 new orders KRW 248,977,933 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: the Yongin plant can build 240 tools a year (LPCVD and others); it produced 62 tools in H1 2026 against 93 in all of FY2025 and 73 in FY2024. All tools are built to order, so the company does not measure utilisation hours.
quarterly_data.figure: Capacity 240 tools/year; 62 tools produced in H1 2026 (FY2025: 93)

quarterly_data.signal: Customers: the report names SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics and Micron as the main customers of the equipment segment and SK Hynix as the customer of EGTM's gases and precursors. Two unnamed customers each exceeded 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026 -- customer A KRW 97,738,056 thousand and customer B KRW 103,791,683 thousand, together KRW 201,529,740 thousand of KRW 223,984,279 thousand (H1 2025: A KRW 52,701,920 thousand, B KRW 117,090,508 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A KRW 97,738,056 thousand; customer B KRW 103,791,683 thousand; combined KRW 201,529,740 thousand of KRW 223,984,279 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Product mix, H1 2026: deposition equipment (single-wafer LPCVD BlueJay, plasma treatment Albatross, batch ALD) KRW 183,866M (82.09%), precursors KRW 7,714M (3.44%), other materials and parts KRW 32,404M (14.47%). Raw materials for equipment (parent-only): wafer-transfer platforms KRW 17,716M (12.9%, Brooks and others), chamber heaters KRW 22,559M (16.4%, Inabata and others), other parts KRW 97,118M (70.7%).
quarterly_data.figure: Equipment KRW 183,866M (82.09%); precursors KRW 7,714M (3.44%); platforms KRW 17,716M, heaters KRW 22,559M

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and next-generation tools: H1 2026 R&D spending KRW 54,372M (24.3% of revenue), with 215 of 499 group employees in R&D. Projects in progress: TiN / TSN ALD deposition tools and processes for capacitor electrodes of 10nm-class DRAM (since 2021.12), a batch-type ALD system for insulating films (since 2023.07) and multi-wafer-loaded epitaxial deposition (since 2024.07); capitalised development programmes include FALCON, BENNU-L, Harrier-M, IBIS and SIERRA, which the company says are in joint development or evaluation with customers. The earlier mini-batch ALD tool for 3D NAND is in sales. Kokusai Electric and one other plaintiff have four patent cases against the company (claims KRW 1,200M); the Korean patent tribunal invalidated 16 claims in one case, and two others are on appeal.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D KRW 54,372M (24.3% of revenue); 215 R&D staff; Kokusai patent suits KRW 1,200M
